title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 tek Kompleksi Delijorgji te rruga e kavajes
description_sq:
Ne nje nga Komplekset me te kerkuara ne Tirane tek Kompleksi Delijorgji shitet apartament 2+1+2+ post parkmi.
Hapesira prej 122 m2 organizohet ne nje sallon i bollshem me kuzhine, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe nje ballkon.
Orientimi ofron drite natyrale gjate gjithe dites.
Shitet i mobiluar.
Kompleksi Delijorgji shquhet per cilesine e ndertimit dhe mirembajtjes, izolim termik dhe akustik.
Siguri 24/7 me roje dhe kamera.
Administrim shume i mire dhe komunitet familjar.
Akses i menjehershem ne Unazen e madhe, 21 Dhjetorin dhe qendren e Tiranes.
Apartamenti shitet bashke me 1 post parkimi ne cmim 35,000 euro.
Nje zgjedhje ideale banimi ose nje investim i sigurt. I dhene aktualisht me qira!
Disponon certefikate pronesie.
title_en: 2+1 Apartment for sale at Delijorgji Complex on Kavaje Street
description_en: In one of the most sought-after Complexes in Tirana, in the Delijorgji Complex, a 2+1+2+ parking post apartment is for sale. The space of 122 m2 is organized in a spacious living room with kitchen, two bedrooms, two toilets and a balcony. The orientation offers natural light throughout the day. For sale furnished. The Delijorgji complex stands out for the quality of construction and maintenance, thermal and acoustic insulation. 24/7 security with guards and cameras. Very good administration and family community. Immediate access to the Great Ring, 21 December and the center of Tirana. The apartment is sold together with 1 parking space at the price of 35,000 euros. An ideal residential choice or a safe investment. Currently rented out! It has ownership certificates.
